cases.title: Pearl order ka poora safar
cases.goal: Raw material se lekar dispatch aur baad mein bill tak, ek hi order ke saath. Do rang ka slip; ek rang bana aur gaya, doosra baaki.

steps.do: Inward: GPPS 206 Semi 300 kg. Moulding task 3MM Round SR. Vinod (M1): 105 kg liya, 100 kg achha. Owner approve.
steps.expect: Moulded stock 100 kg (Pearl)

steps.do: Stock → Dhaga → "Dhaga aaya": 1×2, 10 kg (opening).
steps.expect: 1×2 dhaga 10 kg

steps.do: Karigar → Bhejo: Tausif bhai, 3MM Semi, 100 kg.
steps.expect: Spec 30 ladi × 2 guchha × 100 moti = 6,000 moti / frame, andaaza 1,200 frame (100 kg × 60 bunch/kg × 1,200 ÷ 6,000)

steps.do: "Bhejo + challan banao".
steps.expect: Job-work challan par pirai spec

steps.do: Wapas lo: 301 frame, kul wazan 107.53 kg, grade 1st, dhaga 1×2, receiver Salman.
"Threaded maal aaya" → "Move to Pearl coating".
steps.expect: Lot 1,505 bunch Pearl coating mein · dhaga 10 → 2.473 kg
steps.actual: 1505 bunch · coating mein · P · dhaga 2.473 kg

steps.do: Naya order: Laxmi Lace Works, 3MM Semi Double, Rani Gulabi 10 + Green 10 packet.
steps.expect: Slip no. 224, transport Bhiwandi → Mumbai, 20 packet

steps.do: Save → app batata hai kya kam hai.
steps.expect: Rani Gulabi: "Coating task do (10 packet · 100 frame)"

steps.do: "Coating task do" (Rani Gulabi).
steps.expect: 10 packet → 100 frame (3MM Semi exact 10 frame / packet, allowance abhi nahi)

steps.do: Salman (P1), agle din: work date kal, frames use hue 105, packet bane 10.
Owner: Approval → OK.
steps.expect: Rani Gulabi taiyaar 10 × 50 = 500 bunch · coating reject 25 bunch waste mein
steps.actual: 3MM Round Rani Gulabi: 500 bunch · reject 25 bunch

steps.do: Orders → Party-wise.
steps.expect: Rani Gulabi bane 10 / 10, Green 0 / 10 baaki

steps.do: Dispatch karo: Rani Gulabi 10 packet, gaadi MH04 AB 1234, tareekh kal, "Bill baad mein".
steps.expect: Green 0 (stock nahi), rate box chhupe

steps.do: Save.
steps.expect: Stock 500 → 0, "Bill banana baaki" mein 1

steps.do: Orders page.
steps.expect: "Bill banana baaki": Slip #224, 1 din se baaki

steps.do: Bill banao → rate 10.4 (slip se) → Bill banao.
steps.expect: MK/26-27/0001 · 10 × 50 × 10.4 = 5,200 + CGST/SGST 18% = ₹6,136 · tareekh = dispatch (kal), bill bana = aaj
steps.actual: MK/26-27/0001 · ₹6136 · dispatch ki tareekh · bill bana aaj

cases.title: Karigar slip (P3): grade, dhaga, cut, alert
cases.goal: Owner ki photo P3 wali slip: Tausif · 3 No Semi · 40.400 kg · cut 0.800 · Salman. Grade zaroori, dhaga apne aap, cut waste mein, dhaga kam ho toh alert.

steps.do: Dhaga aaya: 1×2, 5 kg. "Type / reorder": 1×2 ka reorder 3 kg.
steps.expect: Stock 5 kg, reorder 3 kg, abhi alert nahi

steps.do: Slip jaisa bharo (P3): 40.400 kg, cut 0.800, Salman, dhaga 1×2, par grade nahi chuna → Save.
steps.expect: Save nahi hoga: "Grade chuno"
steps.actual: Grade chuno (1st / 2nd / 3rd). Bina grade save nahi hoga.

steps.do: Grade 1st chuno.
steps.expect: Dhaga 40.400 × 70 g = 2.828 kg · stock iske baad 2.172 · cut → Semi waste 1st grade

steps.do: Save.
steps.expect: Maal 37.572 kg · dhaga stock 2.172 kg · Semi waste 2.8 kg (2 kg moulding + 0.800 cut, 1st)

steps.do: Home → bell.
steps.expect: "1×2 dhaga kam: 2.172 kg" (reorder 3 se kam)

steps.do: Stock → Dhaga tab.
steps.expect: 1×2: 2.172 kg, "kam hai", tab par badge

steps.do: Waste page.
steps.expect: "Pirai ka cut · grade ke hisaab se": Semi 1st 0.800 kg

steps.do: Karigar page.
steps.expect: Frame aaye 120 · 1st · dhaga 2.828 · cut 0.800

cases.title: Pehla slip pehle, turant bill, Metalizing ka raasta
cases.goal: Do party ne same maal maanga, stock ek ke liye kaafi: purana slip pehle. Turant bill (IGST), PDF aur WhatsApp. Phir Metalizing ka maal sirf MZ1 ko.

steps.do: Stock: 500 bunch (10 packet). Slip 224 (Shree Ganesh, Surat) 8 packet, slip 225 (Noor Embroidery) 8 packet.
steps.expect: #224 ready (pehla), #225 waiting (bacha 2 packet)

steps.do: Party-wise tab.
steps.expect: Shree Ganesh: Ready to dispatch · Noor: 2 bane / 8
steps.actual: Ready to dispatch · Maal ka intezaar

steps.do: Slip 224 → Dispatch karo → gaadi GJ05 XY 4321 → "Dispatch + bill banao" (Abhi bill banao).
WhatsApp button.
steps.expect: Message mein bill no., party, slip 224, gaadi, total
steps.actual: =*MK Plastics · Beads Bazaar* ⏎ Tax Invoice MK/26-27/0001 · 26/11/2026 ⏎ Shree Ganesh Garments, Surat ⏎ Order slip 224 · Bhiwandi → Surat ⏎ Gaadi: GJ05

steps.do: "PDF download" → browser print → Save as PDF.
steps.expect: Sirf bill ka kaagaz chhapta hai, file ka naam MK-26-27-0001

steps.do: Black PP (Metalizing raw material): inward, moulding task Metalizing line, M1 entry 52 → 50 kg, approve.
steps.expect: Moulded maal sirf Metalizing stock mein

steps.do: Karigar ko bhejo + wapas lo (Black PP ka pirai spec nahi, isliye bunch seedha: 400).
steps.expect: "Move to Metalizing"

steps.do: Coating task: pehle P1 (Pearl), phir MZ1 (Metalizing) chuno.
steps.expect: P1 ko 0 lot, MZ1 ko 1 lot (Black PP)
